mapper.select: select p.id from permission p left join permission_router pr on p.id = pr.permission_id left join router r on pr.router_id = r.id where r.id = #{routerId} and p.deleted = 0 and r.deleted = 0 and pr.deleted = 0 order by p.`order`, p.create_time desc, p.update_time desc

select p.id from permission p left join permission_role r on p.id = r.permission_id left join role ro on r.role_id = ro.id where ro.id = #{roleId} and p.deleted = 0 and r.deleted = 0 and ro.deleted = 0 order by p.`order`, p.create_time desc, p.update_time desc

select p.id, p.name, p.path, p.title, p.note, p.icon, p.component, p.redirect, p.`order`, p.affix, p.hidden, p.parent_id from permission p left join permission_role pr on p.id = pr.permission_id left join role r on pr.role_id = r.id left join user u on r.id = u.role_id where u.id = #{userId} and p.deleted = 0 and pr.deleted = 0 and r.deleted = 0 and u.deleted = 0 order by p.`order`, p.create_time desc, p.update_time desc

select id, name, path, title, note, icon, component, redirect, affix, hidden, parent_id, `order`, deleted, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user from permission where deleted = 0 order by `order`, create_time desc, update_time desc
